'''Brandon Bjerke''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Minneapolis Grand Slam]] on 21 October 2000 with Toche Station / Jabba's Audience Chamber start, according to Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1392">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-grand-slam-minnesotad1392/ grand-slam-minnesota], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 26 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-grand-slam-minnesotad1392/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
